judgments.rationale: Under item (ii), subclauses (I) and (II) are disjunctive alternatives separated by 'or'. Subclause (II) permits inspection 'at any time with respect to records relating to a firearm involved in a criminal investigation that is traced to the licensee', whereas the 'not more than once during any 12-month period' limitation belongs exclusively to subclause (I). The proposed summary incorrectly applies the 12-month frequency restriction to firearm trace records under subclause (II), contradicting the statutory authority.
